# `array_repeat`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
array_repeat(element, count)
```

Returns the array containing element count times.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT array_repeat('123', 2);
```

Result:

```text
["123","123"]
```
